body.description: plain worn wooden market table, seen from a high top-down 2:1 isometric camera, long edge running diagonally from upper left to lower right, thin matte planks, four slim square legs with open gaps between them and a low stretcher; on top three shallow woven baskets of small fruit (muted red, yellow-green, ochre) heaped low, two loose fruit on the planks. dark brown 1 pixel outline, muted earth colours, 3 to 4 flat tone steps per material, warm light from the upper left, no white highlights, no glossy shine, no bevelled plank edges
body.name: badan market g probe1 fruit table
